nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Duo Original & Invisible+ Patches

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with self-described sensitive skin reports no bad reaction to the patches, though results were only partial on some spots.
segments.combination: A reviewer with more combination/oily-prone skin found the patches only worked once a pimple had already fully developed, and considered them less effective than a competitor for oil control.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers describe the patches drawing gunk/pus out of whiteheads and visibly flattening or clearing individual spots overnight or within hours; a minority (3 reviews) say the patch did nothing and the pimple looked unchanged afterward.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with cystic acne, deep chin breakouts, or picking habits report reduced swelling, redness and healing time, and several say the patches curb the urge to pick; one reviewer says patches did not work on deeper or unready pimples.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers note the patch reduces redness and swelling around a pimple by morning, but one reviewer says the adhesive itself left a red mark after removal.

aspects.libelle: Draws out pus or gunk visibly
No effect on undeveloped or deep pimples
Stated wear time longer than package claims
Price seen as high versus competitors
Day vs night patches not clearly labeled

extraits.titre: Doesn't live up to the hype
extraits.texte: I NEVER ever ever write reviews but this product honeslty made me inexplicably upset. I bought these because they were so popular but they did absolutely nothing to help minimize my acne. It just rips of the head off and left a scar on my check. But the fact that I have to wait for the acne to break the skin to have it "work". BUY PEACH SLICES MICRODART PATCHES INSTEAD. They help soooooo much and stops the acne before it breaks the skin.

I've tried these and two other main competitors. I have found these do not work unless it's right on a developed pimple. There is one brand (ZS) that can pull oil from an area that is heavy in oil and I can tell a pimple WILL form if I don't dry the area out a bit. I have found only the ZS brand to work on developed pimples both large and small as well as high oil areas. these patches along with another competitor never seem to draw oil unless, as I stated couple times, there is a developed pimple. So for me these are far inferior than my personal preferred brand. I haven't found these to be useful in multiple scenarios which is a big downside for me considering the cost isn't too competitive compared to the others. I know some people have great success with these and if you suffer from regular breakouts versus more combo skin type issues where you have a lot of oil that you are trying to control I might try these

I am not head over heals for these, although they did help on some spots. I didn't have a bad reaction, I tend to have sensitive skin. The packaging was not clear which were original vs invisible, once on I could tell.

extraits.titre: I would highly recommend this product line
extraits.texte: I have severe cystic acne, so I'm always trying to find ways to minimize the appearance. This product helps with the oozing stage and the inflammation. This helps acne go away with less healing time.

I was skeptical on trying this. I suffer from acne caused primarily by my birth control. My pimples take forever to go down or go away, I used these overnight and omg I would wake up, you can see anything pulled out of it through the patch :), and it always worked to bring down the swelling which causes pain for pimples that havent broke through yet, also works as a disguise for any redness or discoloration. Works literally within a few hours. TRY IT!!!!

extraits.titre: Really works! Even on the most stubborn breakouts!
extraits.texte: I get really bad breakouts on my chin that will not go away no matter what I do. The breakouts are deep and painful. Just in one night the redness and swelling went away!

Love these pimple patches! They stick really well, even overnight, and I wake up with the spot looking flatter and less red. They're super easy to use and blend right into the skin. I've tried lots of acne products, but these actually work without drying my skin out. Definitely recommend!
